evaluations.description: Evaluations of each proposed code. Empty array if no codes to evaluate.

code_label.description: Name of the evaluated code (exact label)

verdict.description: SAT: correct and well defined. MOD: needs refinement. FORCED: no empirical basis.

rationale.description: Detailed justification of the verdict, referencing specific segments.

interchangeability_assessment.description: Are the incidents interchangeable? How do they differ if they are not? If not enough incidents to evaluate: 'Insufficient incidents to evaluate interchangeability.'

suggestion.description: Only if MOD. Concrete action: new label, adjusted definition, or split into subcodes. If not applicable, leave empty string.

overlap_with_existing.description: Names of existing codes with which this one significantly overlaps. Empty array if no overlap.

confidence.description: Critic's confidence in this verdict. 0.0 = total doubt, 1.0 = absolute certainty.
